parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: The image label filter condition. Separate multiple Key=Value conditions with commas.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of records to return in a single request.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The image name filter condition. Supports fuzzy match.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token used to continue a query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page.
